This is a mass spectrum (line/intensity plot), not a bar chart of averaged data; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bars represent single measured proportions (percentage of protein population bound to a given number of metal atoms, determined directly from one native MS spectrum), not means computed across independent replicates with variability to display; no error bars are shown and none are implied.
Same as panel C: bars show single-measurement proportions from native MS rather than averages of replicate samples, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
